name: Video speed controls
description: Adds a small speed panel when visible HTML videos are present: choose a video, adjust playback from 0.25× to 4×, reset to 1× or hide the panel. Detects videos added later. Disable restores speeds changed by this hook. Works with top-level HTML video elements; embedded frames, closed shadow players and fullscreen overlays may not be supported. Runs locally without network requests.
